dedupe_keys.name: harci eu harmonised gridded dataset of critical infrastructures in europe

description: HARCI-EU gives harmonised 1 km grids of major critical infrastructures in Europe, expressed in sector-specific economic units so they can be combined with hazard maps in large-scale risk assessments. It covers the transport, energy, industry and social sectors in 22 GeoTIFF grids for the EU28 and EFTA countries, in the ETRS89 Lambert Azimuthal Equal Area projection, built by downscaling asset records from OpenStreetMap and other sources so that each country's total value per infrastructure type is preserved; validation against independent metrics gave average Pearson coefficients of 0.61 to 0.95 across sectors. It was produced at the European Commission Joint Research Centre in Ispra by F. Batista e Silva, G. Forzieri, M. A. Marin Herrera, A. Bianchi, C. Lavalle and L. Feyen and described in Scientific Data in July 2019. The grids are available for free download from figshare (version 5) under CC BY 4.0, with a ReadMe file. Caveats: harmonisation does not prevent underestimation where assets are missing, and values are exposure proxies, not asset valuations. It supports continental exposure and damage modelling of multi-sector infrastructure; a related record is the Critical Infrastructure Spatial Index.
